Figure 1: Architecture of our UAU-Net framework, in which CVAE-based feature extraction (CV-AFE) and asymmetric BetaENN (AB-ENN) are the core modules for AU detection. After spatio-temporal global feature extraction, the CV-AFE module learns uncertainty-aware features for each AU from local facial regions. With inter-AU dependencies across regions modeled, AB-ENN formulates AU prediction as a binary evidential learning problem, explicitly capturing predictive uncertainty for robust AU classification. ⊗ and ⊕ denote element-wise multiplication and addition, respectively; 𝐶, 𝑆 , and 𝐸 in circles indicate concatenation, split, and expansion.
